trial_title: A Clinical Study of a Natural Remedy for Rheumatoid Arthritis vs. Commonly Used Conventional Medications
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of a combined therapy for rheumatoid arthritis (RA). The combined therapy contained paeoniflorin (Brand name: Pafulin), which has anti-inflammation properties, and Cervus and Cucumis polypeptide injection (Brand name: Songmeile), which has bone healing, pain relieving, and anti-inflammation properties. The hypothesis is that this remedy, which has long been used by the world's largest RA community, is effective and safe when tested

eligibility_table.criterion: active RA, defined by at least 8 swollen joints and at least 10 tender joints (excluding distal interphalangeal joints)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have active RA as defined by the criteria; she has joint pain and nodules but does not meet the swollen and tender joint counts.

eligibility_table.criterion: an erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) of at least 28 mm per hour
eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) at least 28 mm per hour?

eligibility_table.criterion: the 1987 revised American College of Rheumatology (ACR) criteria for diagnosis of RA for at least 6 months
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about the duration of the patient's symptoms or if they meet the ACR criteria for RA diagnosis for at least 6 months.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced joint pain and stiffness for at least 6 weeks, with at least 3 swollen joints and a positive rheumatoid factor test?

eligibility_table.criterion: not use of NSAIDs within two weeks
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is currently taking Tylenol, which is not an NSAID, and there is no indication of NSAID use in the past two weeks.

eligibility_table.criterion: agreement to participate in this study
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not been indicated to have any objections to participating in the study.
There is no information provided regarding the patient's compliance history.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient reported taking their prescribed medications for rheumatoid arthritis at least 80% of the time over the past month?

eligibility_table.justification: The patient has hypertension and hypercholesteremia, but it is unclear if these are considered severe medical conditions in the context of the trial.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have any severe medical conditions, such as heart failure, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, or renal failure, that would contraindicate participation in the study?

eligibility_table.criterion: abnormalities in liver, or kidney function, or in haematological parameters
eligibility_table.justification: There are no lab values provided to assess liver, kidney function, or hematological parameters.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Have the patient's liver function tests (ALT, AST, and bilirubin) and kidney function tests (creatinine and BUN) been measured, and do they fall within the normal reference ranges?

eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication that the patient is pregnant or breastfeeding.
